class.name: GL43Server
class.brief_description: Simplified OpenGL 4.3 compute shader, SSBO, and image load/store server for game code.
class.description: Provides a streamlined, Godot-friendly interface to the shared OpenGL 4.3 Core context ([code]SharedGL43Context[/code]) for running compute shaders, Shader Storage Buffer Objects (SSBOs), Uniform Buffer Objects (UBOs), and image load/store operations alongside Godot's GLES3 renderer. Accepts both [GL43Server]-created textures and standard Godot [Texture] resources (such as [ImageTexture] and [ViewportTexture]). Check [method is_available] before issuing GPU work; only supported on desktop OpenGL 4.3+ drivers when running the GLES3 backend.

method.name: begin
method.description: Switches to the shared GL 4.3 context once for a batch of calls, avoiding per-call context switches. Always pair with [method end].

method.name: bind_compute_shader
method.description: Binds a compute shader program created with [method create_compute_shader].

method.name: bind_image_texture
method.description: Binds a [Texture] or texture [RID] to an image unit for [code]imageLoad[/code]/[code]imageStore[/code] in compute shaders (3D and 2D array textures are automatically bound as layered). Leave [code]format[/code] as [constant FORMAT_AUTO] to match the texture's format automatically.

method.name: bind_image_texture_layer
method.description: Binds a single layer/slice of a 3D or 2D array texture as a 2D image unit.

method.name: bind_ssbo
method.description: Binds an SSBO to a [code]layout(std430, binding = N)[/code] slot.

method.name: bind_texture
method.description: Binds a [Texture] or texture [RID] to a texture sampler unit, and optionally assigns [code]uniform_name[/code] on the currently bound compute shader.

method.name: bind_ubo
method.description: Binds a UBO to a [code]layout(std140, binding = N)[/code] slot.

method.name: clear_ssbo
method.description: Fills an SSBO with a 32-bit unsigned integer value on the GPU.

method.name: clear_texture
method.description: Clears all pixels of a texture to [code]color[/code].

method.name: copy_ssbo
method.description: Copies bytes between two SSBOs directly on the GPU.

method.name: copy_texture
method.description: Copies texels between two textures on the GPU.

method.name: create_compute_shader
method.description: Compiles and links a GLSL 4.3 compute shader. Automatically prepends [code]#version 430 core[/code] if omitted.

method.name: create_ssbo
method.description: Creates a Shader Storage Buffer Object. [code]initial_data[/code] may be [code]null[/code], a [PoolByteArray], [PoolIntArray], [PoolRealArray], [PoolVector2Array], [PoolVector3Array], [PoolColorArray], or a mixed [Array].

method.name: create_texture_2d
method.description: Creates a GPU-only 2D texture usable as both a sampler and an image load/store target. Pass [constant FILTER_LINEAR_MIPMAP] to allocate mipmaps.

method.name: create_texture_2d_array
method.description: Creates a GPU-only 2D texture array. Pass [constant FILTER_LINEAR_MIPMAP] to allocate mipmaps.

method.name: create_texture_3d
method.description: Creates a GPU-only 3D texture.

method.name: set_texture_sampling
method.description: Updates the filtering and wrap mode of a [Texture] or texture [RID].

method.name: create_ubo
method.description: Creates a Uniform Buffer Object.

method.name: dispatch_compute
method.description: Dispatches the currently bound compute shader with the exact workgroup counts.

method.name: dispatch_compute_for_size
method.description: Convenience helper that rounds [code]ceil(width / local_size.x)[/code] etc. and dispatches the compute shader.

method.name: dispatch_compute_indirect
method.description: Dispatches compute workgroups using 3 [code]uint[/code] counts stored in [code]indirect_ssbo[/code].

method.name: end
method.description: Ends a batch started by [method begin] and syncs GPU work back to Godot's render context.

method.name: finish
method.description: Blocks until all queued GL 4.3 GPU commands have completed.

method.name: flush
method.description: Submits queued GL 4.3 commands to the GPU driver without blocking.

method.name: free_rid
method.description: Frees a shader, buffer, or texture [RID] created by [GL43Server].

method.name: generate_mipmaps
method.description: Generates mipmaps on the GPU for a [Texture] or texture [RID].

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the most recent shader compile or link error message.

method.name: get_limits
method.description: Returns hardware compute limits ([code]max_work_group_count[/code], [code]max_work_group_size[/code], [code]max_work_group_invocations[/code], [code]max_shared_memory_bytes[/code], [code]max_ssbo_bindings[/code], [code]max_image_units[/code]).

method.name: get_shader_log
method.description: Returns the compile/link error log for a specific shader [RID], or an empty string if valid.

method.name: get_ssbo_size
method.description: Returns the current allocated size in bytes of an SSBO or UBO.

method.name: get_texture_size
method.description: Returns [code]Vector3(width, height, depth)[/code] for a [Texture] or texture [RID].

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the shared OpenGL 4.3 Core context is active on the current machine and renderer.

method.name: is_rid_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [code]rid[/code] is an active [GL43Server] resource.

method.name: is_shader_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the compute shader compiled and linked successfully.

method.name: memory_barrier
method.description: Inserts a GPU memory barrier so subsequent compute shaders or Godot passes observe prior image/SSBO writes.

method.name: pack_vec3_as_vec4
method.description: Packs a [PoolVector3Array] with 16-byte ([code]vec4[/code]) stride for GLSL [code]std430[/code] SSBOs.

method.name: read_ssbo
method.description: Reads raw bytes back from an SSBO on the render thread.

method.name: read_ssbo_floats
method.description: Reads 32-bit floats back from an SSBO on the render thread.

method.name: read_ssbo_ints
method.description: Reads 32-bit signed ints back from an SSBO on the render thread.

method.name: read_texture_2d
method.description: Reads a 2D texture back from the GPU into an [Image] on the render thread.

method.name: reload_compute_shader
method.description: Recompiles an existing compute shader [RID] in place with new GLSL code.

method.name: resize_texture_2d
method.description: Resizes a 2D texture created by [method create_texture_2d].

method.name: set_uniform
method.description: Sets a uniform ([code]bool[/code], [code]int[/code], [code]float[/code], [code]Vector2[/code], [code]Vector3[/code], [code]Color[/code], [code]Plane[/code], [code]Quat[/code], [code]Rect2[/code], [code]Basis[/code], [code]Transform2D[/code], [code]Transform[/code], or typed arrays) on the currently bound compute shader.

method.name: set_uniform_color
method.description: Sets a [code]vec4[/code] color uniform, optionally converting from sRGB to linear space.

method.name: set_uniform_inv_ortho
method.description: Sets an inverse orthographic [code]mat4[/code] projection uniform.

method.name: set_uniform_inv_projection
method.description: Sets an inverse perspective [code]mat4[/code] projection uniform matching Godot's [Camera] convention.

method.name: set_uniform_ortho
method.description: Sets an orthographic [code]mat4[/code] projection uniform.

method.name: set_uniform_projection
method.description: Sets a perspective [code]mat4[/code] projection uniform matching Godot's [Camera] convention.

method.name: unbind_compute_shader
method.description: Unbinds the active compute shader.

method.name: unbind_image_texture
method.description: Unbinds an image texture from [code]unit[/code].

method.name: unbind_ssbo
method.description: Unbinds an SSBO from [code]binding_index[/code].

method.name: unbind_texture
method.description: Unbinds any texture bound to sampler [code]unit[/code].

method.name: unbind_ubo
method.description: Unbinds a UBO from [code]binding_index[/code].

method.name: upload_ssbo
method.description: Uploads data into an SSBO, automatically reusing allocation via [code]glBufferSubData[/code] if size and usage match.

method.name: upload_ssbo_subdata
method.description: Updates a slice of an existing SSBO starting at [code]byte_offset[/code].

method.name: upload_texture_2d
method.description: Uploads an [Image] into a 2D texture.

method.name: upload_ubo
method.description: Uploads data into a UBO.
